session.doneScience: Your brain will now start forgetting… that's normal and planned: Memoriq will bring each verse back right before you forget it. That's spaced repetition.

onboarding.slide1Body: In 1885, Hermann Ebbinghaus measured the "forgetting curve": without review, most of what we learn is lost within days.
onboarding.slide2Body: Each well-timed review flattens the curve. Memoriq computes the ideal review date for every verse — right before you'd forget it — using the FSRS algorithm.
onboarding.slide3Body: Reciting from memory is about twice as effective as rereading (Roediger & Karpicke, 2006). Memoriq progressively hides the text so you recite, not reread.
onboarding.slide4Body: The traditional hifz method — sabaq (new lesson), sabqi (recent review), manzil (older review) — is exactly what science recommends. Memoriq optimizes it verse by verse.
